thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate (us-west-2) — severity: P1. Trigger: rate > 7% sustained for 2m. Paging on-call. runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/http-5xx-usw2

sam: On it. jumping in — what’s the current traffic split? any recent deploys to canary?

maria: I got inbound CS tickets, customers asking if requests are failing or slow. Need an impact summary we can paste into Zendesk.

lee: Reproducing now. Looking at ingress logs and LB metrics. Early symptom: backend model nodes returning 502 from runtime layer, not LB. Pasting last 30s sample logs:
```
2026-03-15T14:12:01Z runtime-23 error: kv cache miss -> fallback compile path; token loop failed with OOM (gpu0)
2026-03-15T14:12:02Z runtime-23 warn: model-variant-a timeout after 1.8s
2026-03-15T14:12:03Z runtime-17 error: http 502 stream closed by peer
```

lee: No deploys in the last hour per deploy-bot. Appears to be resource exhaustion on a subset of GPU nodes. Memory growth on runtime for long chat sessions.

sam: Can we scale up Dedicated pool or spin up fallback nodes (quantized model)? If we can route heavy sessions to a lower-memory variant that might mitigate quickly.

tara: I’m going to enable circuit-breaker rule and reduce max-connections for /v1/generate to protect control plane. Applying policy now: `cb-enable --route /v1/generate --max-inflight 80`

incident-bot: Deploy event queued: circuit-breaker rule applied by tara at 14:13:05Z.

lee: Quick mitigation applied: routing 20% traffic to model-variant-b (8-bit quantized). Running healthcheck... OK. Error rate dropped from 8.4% -> 3.1% in 2 minutes.

maria: Drafting status page and CS reply. Please confirm impact numbers and ETA for full mitigation. Propose posting: 

Status page draft:
```
Title: Partial outage affecting text generation in us-west-2
Impact: Some requests to /v1/generate may return errors or experience elevated latency. We are seeing increased 5xx rates for heavy/long sessions.
Next update: in 15 minutes
What we’re doing: Routing traffic to fallback model variants, applying circuit breakers to limit load, and scaling runtime capacity.
```

maria: CS macro draft for Zendesk (short):
```
Hi — thanks for flagging this. We’re aware of elevated errors for the text-generation endpoint in us-west-2. Our engineers have applied mitigations (traffic routing + circuit breakers) and error rates are improving. If you’re seeing repeated failures, please include a sample request ID and timestamp and we’ll prioritize it. We expect a full resolution in < 1 hour. Apologies for the disruption. — Maria (Support)
```

paul: Add this optional troubleshooting checklist for agents:
- Ask for request_id and timestamp from the customer.
- Check status.redwood.com for region status.
- If request_id shows 502/5xx, escalate to oncall with logs and sample payload.
- If customer needs immediate mitigation for critical workflow, offer to reroute them to region eus or us-east (if available).

maria: Good. Also include an internal snippet for faster handoffs (for new oncall):
```
Handoff checklist:
- State: current error rate (5xx %), effected route(s), mitigation applied (traffic-split, CB), estimated capacity to add.
- Actions to resume: scale runtime by N GPUs or roll a canary of model-variant-b -> monitor for 5xx reduction.
- Customer comms: paste status page + CS macro.
```

sam: FYI I kicked a temporary autoscale: `scale-runtime --region usw2 --add-gpus 4 --ttl 20m`. That should relieve pressure while we confirm memory leak.

lee: Confirming memory growth traces pinned to long-lived KV cache entries for a specific client pattern (very long prompts). Adding a guard to evict caches older than 5m as a short-term fix. Patch diff being rolled now.

incident-bot: Patch roll (evict-kv-cache) started by lee at 14:19:20Z. CI checks pass. Canary rollout to 10% of nodes.

tara: Oncall handoff at 14:25: incoming: paul takes post-incident monitoring.

paul: I’ll watch error rates and customer queues. If 5xx < 1% and stable for 10 min, I’ll close the incident and draft final status.

maria: Final checklist for CS macros (to add to macro library):
- Subject: Service disruption affecting text generation (us-west-2)
- Body: short summary, link to status, what we did, ETA, ask for request IDs
- Tag macro: `incident-usw2-gen-2026-03-15`

cs-bot: Macro saved: incident-usw2-gen-2026-03-15. Use `/macro incident-usw2-gen-2026-03-15` to insert.

maria: Will post status page update in 10 min with current numbers. If anything regresses ping me and I’ll send an immediate customer update. :thumbsup:

sam: Thanks everyone. Good triage — follow-up action item: open an RFC for KV cache eviction heuristic + long-prompt client protections.

paul: Current metrics snapshot at 14:29:00Z: 5xx rate 0.6% (down from 8.4%), avg latency 320ms, affected requests concentrated in sessions with >3000 token prefix.

maria: Closing customer-facing message: posting to status.redwood.com now and updating active tickets with macro.

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated. Monitoring. Logged: https://redwood/incidents/1798012345

paul: Leaving a short handoff note for next oncall: if error climbs above 2% re-open incident, scale additional 4 GPUs and remove long-session traffic for 30m.

tara: acknowledged.

sam: thanks all — file follow-up items in /pm/inference and tag eng-runtime, eng-ml.

maria: Great job team, will prep the post-incident customer summary once we confirm root cause from eng-ml.
